# xatlas

Automatic UV unwrapping (chart segmentation, parameterization and packing), from
https://github.com/jpcy/xatlas at commit f700c7790aaa030e794b52ba7791a05c085faf0c,
unmodified. MIT License (see LICENSE). Built by `build.rs` with its C API
(`XATLAS_C_API=1`); the Rust side is `src/unwrap.rs`.
